title: Sum of first N numbers
problemStatement: Compute S(N) = 1+2+…+N. Show recursive thinking and the closed form.
intuition: Recurrence: S(N)=N+S(N−1), S(0)=0. Also S(N)=N(N+1)/2 — interviewers expect both, and overflow notes for fixed-width ints.

approaches.title: Brute: loop
approaches.code:
def sum_n_loop(n: int) -> int:
    return sum(range(1, n + 1))
limitations: Fine for teaching; O(n) unnecessary once formula is known

approaches.title: Recursive recurrence
limitations: Stack depth n — use formula in practice

approaches.title: Optimal: closed form
approaches.code:
def sum_n(n: int) -> int:
    return n * (n + 1) // 2
approaches.whyWorks: Pair 1+(N), 2+(N−1), … → N/2 pairs each summing to N+1.

commonMistakes: Integer overflow on n*(n+1) before divide in C++
interviewInsight: Moving recurrence → closed form is the optimization story they want.

related.title: Time Complexity [Learn Basics, and then analyse in next Steps]

patternRecognition: Problems with simple linear recurrence often have closed forms
